note: This outage is a synthetic GNSS mask applied to otherwise-continuous driving, not a real tunnel dropout -- PLAN.md documents that the dataset's real GPS dropouts have no ground truth and are excluded from all evaluation. Ground truth positions here are the recorded GPS fixes, held between updates the same way the source data holds them.
source: eval pipeline (shadownav.pipeline_kinematic), same split/seed as eval/results/kinematic.json
